stem: Leaf-edge stress is concentrated in one corner of a flowering room. Root-zone data and irrigation output match the rest of the room, but canopy sensors in that corner repeatedly run warmer. What is the strongest next diagnostic step?
choices: Increase nutrient concentration for the whole room
Verify the local temperature/radiant-load and airflow pattern before changing room-wide irrigation or nutrition
Ignore the spatial pattern because the controller average is acceptable
rationale: The localized pattern and supporting temperature evidence make local environmental load/airflow the strongest next verification target.
